records.title: Scaling Properties of Same-Family On-Policy Distillation
records.reason: Scaling properties of same-family on-policy distillation are a training dynamics study; no inference-efficiency contribution is described.

records.title: CUA-Sandbox: Efficient Environments for Computer-Use Agent Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: CUA-Sandbox reduces memory and initialization costs for computer-use agent RL rollout environments; it optimizes training infrastructure, not LLM inference/serving.

records.title: MOPD-Router: Rethinking Teacher Routing in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
records.reason: MOPD-Router routes teacher supervision during on-policy distillation; it targets training-time model updates, not inference serving.

records.title: Strategically Diverse Sampling for Self-Training
records.reason: Strategically diverse sampling constructs self-training data and initializations for RL/test-time scaling; the method optimizes training data generation, not inference resource use.

records.title: Understanding the Synergy between SFT, RLVR, and OPD in LLM Post-Training
records.reason: This paper studies interactions among SFT, RLVR and OPD in post-training pipelines; it is training-only.
